name: smwgraphics-breath-of-fire-ii-overworld
title: Breath of Fire II - Overworld
description:
The world map graphics from Breath of Fire II. Everything except the rugged ground tiles is included due to palette space. There are also a few tiles like the waterfall that has been edited in order to work better with the palette animations in order for the animations to sync up better. Includes an alternate palette for the buildings. Uses palettes 2 through 7 and 4 graphic files. Suggested by TheMorganah.
